  Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.

  Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.

Color identity: RGWU | Bracket: Ruthless | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{G}{G} each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Feather, the Redeemed (battlefield); Sage of Hours (battlefield); Strength of the Tajuru (hand)
Steps: Cast Strength of the Tajuru by paying {4}{G}{G}, targeting Sage of Hours.
  Sage of Hours and Feather trigger.
  Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Resolve the Feather trigger, causing you to exile Strength of the Tajuru as it resolves.
  Resolve Strength of the Tajuru, putting four +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours and exiling Strength of the Tajuru.
  Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
  At the beginning of your end step, Feather triggers, returning Strength of the Tajuru from exile to your hand.
  Repeat each turn.

## Combo 1494-1991-2744

Color identity: RGWU | Bracket: Ruthless | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Lock; Infinite turns
Start: Tana, the Bloodsower (battlefield); Sage of Hours (battlefield); Cathars' Crusade (battlefield)

  Repeat each turn.

## Combo 1525-1974-2031-2406-2660
Cards: Lightning Storm + Stormchaser Drake + Wheel of Sun and Moon + Abundance + Quicksilver Gargantuan
Color identity: RGWU | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{R}{R}
Produces: Infinite self-discard triggers; Infinite damage to one opponent
Start: Lightning Storm (hand); Stormchaser Drake (battlefield); Wheel of Sun and Moon (battlefield); Abundance (battlefield); Quicksilver Gargantuan (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Quicksilver Gargantuan is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
  Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
Steps: Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
  Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
  Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
  Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
  Repeat from step 2.
  Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
Notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.
